entities.title: ZAZZLE_DAEMON
entities.summary: The zazzled executable the invoker starts when nothing listens on the socket, and execs for `zazzle run` and `zazzle proxy`.
entities.default: zazzled in the same directory as zazzle's own executable
entities.scope: One zazzle process, only when it has to start a daemon (it runs `ZAZZLE_DAEMON serve` with zazzle's environment) or when the command is `run` or `proxy` (it becomes `ZAZZLE_DAEMON wrap ...` or `ZAZZLE_DAEMON proxy ...`). The standalone tools are always taken from beside the invoker.
entities.validation: Longer than 511 bytes: `ZAZZLE_DAEMON too long`, exit 78. If zazzle cannot find its own path and ZAZZLE_DAEMON is unset: `daemon not running`, exit 69.
entities.details: zazzle also reads ZAZZLE_SOCK (with HOME for the default) and ZAZZLE_SESSION; their meaning is the daemon's and is recorded in the daemon's configuration.

relationships.description: A daemon zazzle starts inherits zazzle's environment, so ZAZZLE_IDLE_SECS set for zazzle applies to it.
